title: Import transactions
subtitle: Upload a CSV file or paste rows, review the preview, then confirm.

columns.date: Date and time of the trade, e.g. 2025-01-15 or 2025-01-15T09:30:00Z.
columns.coin: Coin ticker or name, e.g. BTC or bitcoin.
columns.price: Price per unit, in the transaction currency.
columns.currency: USD, EUR, SAR or TRY. Optional, defaults to your base currency.
columns.fee: Fee paid, if any. Optional, defaults to 0.

errors.empty: Choose a CSV file or paste CSV text first.
errors.tooLarge: That file is larger than 1 MB. Split it into smaller files and try again.

fixErrorsHint: Fix the errors in your file, then upload it again to import.
